units.text: INT. SEAGULL - CONTINUOUS
Stay just one hour more, and all. Come now, really, you know.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Struggling against her desire to stay; through her tears.
No, no, I can’t.
units.name: NINA

units.text: She shakes hands with him and quickly goes out.

An unlucky girl! They say that her mother left the whole of an immense fortune to her husband, and now the child is penniless because the father has already willed everything away to his second wife. It is pitiful.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Yes, her papa is a perfect beast, and I don’t mind saying so--it is what he deserves.
units.name: DORN

units.text: Rubbing his chilled hands.
Come, let us go in; the night is damp, and my legs are aching.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Yes, you act as if they were turned to stone; you can hardly move them. Come, you unfortunate old man.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: She takes his arm.
Offering his arm to his wife.
Permit me, madame.
units.name: SHAMRAEFF

units.text: I hear that dog howling again. Won’t you please have it unchained, Shamraeff?
units.name: SORIN

units.text: No, I really can’t, sir. The granary is full of millet, and I am afraid thieves might break in if the dog were not there.
units.name: SHAMRAEFF

units.text: Walking beside MEDVIEDENKO.
Yes, a whole octave lower: “Bravo, Silva!” and he wasn’t a singer either, just a simple church cantor.
units.name: SHAMRAEFF

units.text: What salary does the church pay its singers?
units.name: MEDVIEDENKO

units.text: All go out except DORN.

I may have lost my judgment and my wits, but I must confess I liked that play. There was something in it. When the girl spoke of her solitude and the Devil’s eyes gleamed across the lake, I felt my hands shaking with excitement. It was so fresh and naive. But here he comes; let me say something pleasant to him.
units.name: DORN

units.text: TREPLIEFF comes in.
All gone already?
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: I am here.
units.name: DORN

units.text: Masha has been yelling for me all over the park. An insufferable creature.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Constantine, your play delighted me. It was strange, of course, and I did not hear the end, but it made a deep impression on me. You have a great deal of talent, and must persevere in your work.
units.name: DORN

units.text: TREPLIEFF seizes his hand and squeezes it hard, then kisses him impetuously.

Tut, tut! how excited you are. Your eyes are full of tears. Listen to me. You chose your subject in the realm of abstract thought, and you did quite right. A work of art should invariably embody some lofty idea. Only that which is seriously meant can ever be beautiful. How pale you are!
units.name: DORN

units.text: So you advise me to persevere?
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Yes, but use your talent to express only deep and eternal truths. I have led a quiet life, as you know, and am a contented man, but if I should ever experience the exaltation that an artist feels during his moments of creation, I think I should spurn this material envelope of my soul and everything connected with it, and should soar away into heights above this earth.
units.name: DORN

units.text: I beg your pardon, but where is Nina?
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: And yet another thing: every work of art should have a definite object in view. You should know why you are writing, for if you follow the road of art without a goal before your eyes, you will lose yourself, and your genius will be your ruin.
units.name: DORN

units.text: Impetuously.
Where is Nina?
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: She has gone home.
units.name: DORN

units.text: In despair.
Gone home? What shall I do? I want to see her; I must see her! I shall follow her.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: My dear boy, keep quiet.
units.name: DORN

units.text: I am going. I must go.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: MASHA comes in.
Your mother wants you to come in, Mr. Constantine. She is waiting for you, and is very uneasy.
units.name: MASHA

units.text: Tell her I have gone away. And for heaven’s sake, all of you, leave me alone! Go away! Don’t follow me about!
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Come, come, old chap, don’t act like this; it isn’t kind at all.
units.name: DORN

units.text: Through his tears.
Good-bye, doctor, and thank you.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: TREPLIEFF goes out.
Sighing.
